subsections.title: Senior Units:
subsections.text:
Preferred Units: Senior Units have priority in both payment and liquidation over all other Coulton Creek Capital equity holders.
Fixed Returns: 6.5% - 8.0% per annum fixed return, with quarterly distributions.
Diversification: Units are invested across entire CCC platform (approx. 60+ investments).
Minimum Equity Ratio: 1:1 ratio of all Coulton Creek equity to Senior Units and long-term debt.
Transferrable: Units can be converted to other investments with CCC.
Liquidity: Redeem up to 10% every 6 months (full redemption in 5 years).

subsections.title: Class B Shares:
subsections.text:
Ownership Units: Coulton Creek Membership Units paying 8% preferred return with additional profit share.
Priority: Subordinate to Senior Units and Company Debt, pari passu with Class A / Founder Units.
Targeted Returns: 10% to 15% per annum, distributed quarterly.
Historic Track Record: 13.6% average annual returns since inception (9/2020).
Diversification: Units are invested across entire CCC platform (approx. 60+ investments).
Liquidity: Redeem up to 10% every 6 months (full redemption in 5 years).

sections.title: Direct Investments (SPVs):
sections.text:
Optionality: Project-Level investments that allow investors to seek opportunities specific to their investment priorities.
Priority: Structure and waterfall are deal specific, and payouts are independent of Coulton Creek entity investments.
Targeted Returns: Return targets vary by offering, but opportunities are often available across the capital stack from participating in 1st DOT senior loans to traditional LP equity.
Historic Track Record: SPV investments 9-13%+ current cash returns, 14.2% average LP total returns.
Liquidity: Investment timing and liquidity varies by specific investment offering.
